header.description: The matched-k random-subspace control a localization result needs at every cell, which no preset provided until this one. An UNTRAINED `subspace` featurizer is already a random orthonormal rank-k basis: Subspace.__init__ takes qr(randn(width, k, generator=manual_seed(seed))), and build_stack constructs it from k + seed with no `train` section and no `file_path`. So the control is this document with `k` matched to the fitted DAS and `seed` swept, and the sweep IS the control distribution: three random rank-8 subspaces at the same cell, scored the same way as the fit. A single random draw is an anecdote; the spread is what says whether the fit's IIA is about the subspace or about the rank.
